name: print-social-ad-vr-headset-orange-spec-callout
title: Orange VR headset ad with dotted spec callout lines
whatItIs: A square product ad on an orange gradient background, featuring a dramatic close-up VR headset photo with thin white dotted lines pointing to four spec callouts (audio, visuals, refresh rate, frame weight).
whatItMeans: Dotted callout lines pointing from specific product parts to labeled specs let a single hero photo double as a mini spec sheet, common in premium tech advertising.
techniques: point thin dotted leader lines from specific product details to surrounding spec labels
angle the hero product diagonally across the frame for dynamic energy
use a warm gradient background to contrast against a cool-toned metallic product

vocabulary.definition: a thin line connecting a label to the specific part of an image it describes
